problem_strength: Strong and constrained: representation sensitivity is replicated on two real systems and partial-overlap residual survives whole-package pruning/global reweighting.
mechanism_assessment: Identity-Mass Refinement Dependence is stronger than generic overlap normalization because it makes representation invariance of the evolving control law the object and identifies failure of artifact-ID counting under refinement.
reviewer_strongest_same_information_base: Context-conditioned neural simplex router with the same task context, precomputed support fingerprints, exact-clone quotienting, capacity, and fixed control/retrieval budget.
causal_timing_followup: Author Skill-SP code establishes that sample_skill() runs before the proposer task exists and sees only skill-level stats. Therefore a task-context-conditioned router has post-treatment information for the upstream curriculum decision and is not a valid same-information baseline for that specific control surface. It remains a valid strong baseline for post-context retrieval/credit surfaces. The upstream baseline must be restricted to pre-task observable library/support/statistics information.
method_stop_rule: If a generic controller using only the same pre-decision information and budget matches SQC on transformation invariance and evolution utility, stop the standalone SQC method claim.
fatal_risks: Generic same-information control may reproduce SQC, making the method reducible even if STRI remains a valid diagnostic principle.
A faithful qualified dynamic P0 may show no meaningful propagation; then downstream paper claims must be dropped.
Adaptive switching among multiple backbones/substrates after seeing results is prohibited.
